zh.title: 長榮與華航參展亞太永續博覽會展示減碳成果
zh.summary: 長榮航空與中華航空於台北參展亞太永續博覽會，呈現各項減碳與航機規劃成果。
body: 2026年亞太永續博覽會於8月27日至29日在台北世貿一館舉行。長榮航空與中華航空均參與展出，分享其在節能減碳與航空永續轉型方面的各項實踐成果。
長榮航空今年為第三度參展。展區聚焦於淨零轉型與永續航空燃油等面向，並呈現多項節能減碳措施。其規劃包括持續擴大波音787客機機隊，並引進空中巴士A350-1000與A321neo等新世代節能航機，同時透過大數據優化航路與引擎清洗提升燃油效率。
中華航空則為首度參展，以永續和淨零為主題。華航在展區分享了攜手合作夥伴推動永續的成果，帶領民眾認識包含永續航空燃油、空地面減碳、機上資源循環利用等行動，以期擴大落實ESG願景。

en.title: EVA Air and China Airlines Showcase Decarbonization at Sustainability Expo
en.summary: EVA Air and China Airlines present fleet planning and carbon-reduction initiatives at the Taipei expo.
body: The 2026 Asia-Pacific Sustainability Expo is being held from August 27 to 29 at the Taipei World Trade Center Exhibition Hall 1. Taiwanese carriers EVA Air and China Airlines are participating to showcase their respective carbon-reduction and sustainable aviation efforts.

EVA Air, participating for the third time, is highlighting its energy-saving measures. These initiatives include expanding its Boeing 787 fleet, planning the introduction of Airbus A350-1000 and A321neo aircraft, and utilizing big data to optimize flight paths and engine washing to improve fuel efficiency.

China Airlines is making its debut at the expo. The carrier is sharing its sustainability practices under the theme of net-zero emissions, showcasing its efforts in sustainable aviation fuel, ground and cabin carbon reduction, and passenger resource recycling to support its ESG vision.

zh.title: 維珍大西洋擬兩個月後開闢14小時新不經停航線首次飛往該國
zh.summary: 維珍大西洋計劃兩個月內推出14小時長航線首度服務該目的地國家
body: 維珍大西洋航空計劃於兩個月內推出一條飛行時間約14小時的主要新不經停航線，這將是該航空公司首次飛往該目的地國家。
此消息來自航空新聞網站Simple Flying於2026年8月27日發布的報導，標題為「Virgin Atlantic Launches Major New 14-Hour Nonstop Route In 2 Months」。
報告摘要指出「It'll be the first time the airline has flown to this country」，確認此為該航司首度服務該國市場。

en.title: Virgin Atlantic Plans Major New 14-Hour Nonstop Route Launch in Two Months
en.summary: Virgin Atlantic to launch 14-hour nonstop route in two months; first service to destination country
body: Virgin Atlantic plans to launch a major new nonstop route with a flight time of approximately 14 hours in two months, marking the airline's first ever service to the destination country, according to a Simple Flying report published on August 27, 2026.

The headline of the report describes the route as a "major new 14-hour nonstop route" launching in two months, while the summary explicitly notes it will be the first time the airline has flown to this country.
Simple Flying published the report on August 27, 2026, at 11:00 UTC, providing the initial public announcement of this planned network addition by Virgin Atlantic.

zh.title: 菲航宣布2026年11月起馬尼拉墨爾本增至每日直飛
zh.summary: 菲航宣布11月19日起馬尼拉墨爾本增至每日直飛
body: 菲律賓航空（PAL）宣布自2026年11月19日起，將馬尼拉至墨爾本航線從每週五班增加至每日營運。
根據更新後的班表，PR 209航班將於當地時間20:20自馬尼拉起飛，隔日當地時間07:30抵達墨爾本；回程PR 210於當地時間09:20離開墨爾本，當地時間14:25抵達馬尼拉。
菲航表示，該航線自1971年開航以來服務墨爾本，屆時於2026年9月10日滿55週年。目前菲航每日服務布里斯本及雪梨，另有每周三班飛往伯斯。

en.title: Philippine Airlines to upgrade Manila-Melbourne service to daily flights from November 19, 2026
en.summary: PAL raises Manila-Melbourne to daily flights from Nov 19, 2026
body: Philippine Airlines (PAL) announced it will increase its Manila-Melbourne service from five weekly flights to daily operations starting November 19, 2026. Flight PR 209 will depart Manila at 20:20 local time and arrive in Melbourne at 07:30 local time the following day. The return flight, PR 210, will depart Melbourne at 09:20 local time and arrive in Manila at 14:25 local time, operating daily.
The airline noted it will mark 55 years of service to Melbourne on September 10, 2026. PAL currently operates daily services to Brisbane and Sydney, along with three weekly flights to Perth.
